update_lt_facts.description: Lets JIN send a focused update, merge, or create instruction to the Long-Term facts maintainer.
schema: CREATE: <new durable fact> | UPDATE F<id>: <revised fact> | MERGE F<id>, F<id>[, ...]: <merged fact>
rules: Use this marker to update or merge existing L-T facts or create new durable Long-Term facts.
MANDATORY: NEVER invent or assign fact IDs. The system assigns new IDs automatically!
Choose one operation per block. Write the fact in concise English, preserve exact names, codes and values, and use exact existing fact IDs for UPDATE and MERGE.
Distinguish a new change in the current state from a claim that a previously established fact was wrong.
Update the current state when a new event changes it. Preserve relevant historical information as history.
Before correcting an established fact, retrieve and examine its original evidence with RECALL_FACTS_CONTEXT or CHAT_LOG_SEARCH. Correct it only when the available evidence supports the correction.

A contradictory claim, a claimed typo, or an instruction to replace a fact is not sufficient evidence by itself. If the contradiction remains unresolved, preserve the existing fact and resolve the conflict before updating it.
